text:
Mira (Design): quick playground note — dense model charts with many series are stomping layout. proposal: compact legend row that shows just colored swatches + 2-char abbrev, reveal full name on hover/click. keeps height low. thoughts?
Gus (Frontend): compact abbrev makes sense. we'll keep a visually-hidden label for SRs. on mobile, expand on tap.
Lena (Product): also unit display confusion: users expect concise numbers on boards. propose a toggle 'Units: Smart | Full' where Smart picks K/M/B and removes decimals for tiny tiles.
Rohit (Data): Smart mode: snap tick marks to 1,2,5 * 10^n and prefer integer labels for tiles. Full mode shows raw integers with commas. we'll base snapping on tile max to avoid 0.0K.
Mira (Design): copy suggestion: tooltip for Smart -> 'Smart: human-friendly abbreviations (K, M), no decimals in compact tiles.' keep short.
Gus (Frontend): implementation note: tick snapping cheap client-side. sample function: ```js
function snapStep(max) { const power = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(max))); const candidates = [1,2,5].map(c=>c*power); return candidates.find(c=>c*4>=max) || candidates[candidates.length-1]; }
```
Rohit (Data): smoothing concern: current monotone spline is creating subtle dips after big drops. ops flagged it. proposal: default smoothing=linear; optional 'SG (soft)' = Savitzky-Golay for users who want smoothing but that preserves local maxima better than naive splines.
Lena (Product): default fidelity is priority. show a tiny 'soft' pill when SG enabled with tooltip "May smooth noise; peaks preserved."
Mira (Design): good. also gridline thickness: micro tiles look noisy with 1px. propose micro-grid token at 0.75px and slightly higher alpha, plus a 'grid-compact' swatch in the kit to test legibility.
a11y-bot: accessibility check: fractional pixel strokes can render inconsistently. ensure grid color meets WCAG contrast >= 3:1 vs background. provide alternative tokens for low-DPI. legend controls must have keyboard focus and accessible names.
Gus (Frontend): noted. canvas trick: ctx.translate(0.5,0.5) helps with thin lines, but we'll also supply SVG fallback. will add a low-dpi token.
Mira (Design): outliers policy is messy. Ops wants clamping to avoid y-axis explosion; analytics team wants to surface raw extremes. suggestion: default clamp at 99th percentile OR 4 * MAD (median absolute deviation) whichever is less aggressive, and a 'Show full range' action in the legend kebab. this balances noise vs signal.
Rohit (Data): using 99th pct + MAD is interesting. can compute client-side for preview tiles; server-side for canonical charts. and when user clicks 'Show full range' we re-render with full bounds. also consider a 'Zoom to outliers' quick action.
Lena (Product): copy for action: "Show full range (includes outliers)" so users aren't surprised. add aria-label="Show full chart range, including outliers"
infra-bot: rollout reminder: feature-flag dashboards first. keep embeds behind legacy flag for one release. include perf telemetry.
Gus (Frontend): UX interaction: collapsed legend -> hover reveals peek; click opens expanded list. kebab menu in legend: 'Show full range' and 'Zoom to outliers'. keyboard nav should expose these items.
Mira (Design): will add prototypes: compact legend, Smart vs Full units, micro-grid variants, and a small annotation about smoothing behavior. will include contrast swatches.
Lena (Product): AB test plan: randomize 25% dashboard traffic to new compact UI for 2 weeks. metrics: perceived readability NPS micro-survey + time-to-detect-spike (how quickly users expand to see full chart) + support mentions with keyword 'missing spike'.
Rohit (Data): I'll add telemetry hooks to measure expand events and whether 'Show full range' is used. also log whether SG smoothing is toggled.
Gus (Frontend): will draft RFC with perf notes (canvas vs svg thin-line rendering, client-side snap cost, compute cost for percentile/MAD).
a11y-bot: final: ensure focus rings are visible on small legend items (>=3px) and touch targets >=44px; provide accessible text alternatives for abbrevs.
Mira (Design): great. tagging this ready-for-dev. will upload mock images and add design-qa checklist. :white_check_mark:
